chip.description: Five-channel wavetable generator playing 32-byte signed 8-bit waveforms from on-die waveform RAM; the SCC1, functionally the sound half of the Konami MSX SCC cartridges (taxonomy §4.13 example).
chip.notes: src/devices/sound/k051649.cpp in MAME 0.288: "The 051649 is a 5 channel sound generator, each channel gets its waveform from RAM (32 bytes per waveform, 8 bit signed data)."
